firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to support separate login pages for customers and sellers. It provides secure and scalable storage for customer and seller profiles, as well as fish listings. A top-level `fishListings` collection is used to allow for public, unauthenticated listing queries, which is a common pattern for marketplace apps. FishListing documents contain denormalized seller information (name, phone) to avoid costly and complex joins in client-side code and security rules.
